summary: Union County, OR tower on Wallowa-Whitman NF: 61' wooden tower (1933), 82' R-6 tower (1960), gone by 1981; no current site description found.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and firelookout.com say gone in 1981; Forest Lookouts marks it Removed with no date. No source gives the method or exact date, so the story says only that it was gone by 1981.
Dean Masterson (1954, firelookout.com) and Keith Masterson (1962, Forest Lookouts) are different first names in different sources; we did not assume they are the same person.

notes_for_editor: Brief record matches sources (status gone, tower type, Union County, elevation 4,716 ft). The 1933 and 1960 tower dates agree across Register and firelookout.com; the 1981 gone date too. Only the Forest Lookouts page gives a 1935 panorama entry and the 1958 and 1962 newspaper items. A 1978 NADB citation (Kesselman, Preliminary Cultural Resources Report, Bally Mountain Salvage Sale, tDAR 158488) lists 'Lookout' as a keyword, but tDAR holds only the citation, so it was not used. No source describes the site today, its access, or any remains. Photo credit on firelookout.com (courtesy Umatilla National Forest) has no image URL in our cache, so no photos were added.
